test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Janhvi and Pranitha are standing at the extreme ends of a row in which all the students are facing the north. Only 26 students are standing between Janhvi and Ravi. Only 14 students are standing between Ravi and Pranitha. Total how many students are standing in the line?
solution: The logic followed here is: Let the position of Janhvi be J and the position of Pranitha be P. Only 26 students are standing between Janhvi and Ravi, so the total number of students including Janhvi and Ravi would be 26 + 2 = 28.
